scripts.test:k6: mkdir -p reports; rm -f reports/k6-summary.json reports/k6-timeseries.json reports/k6-report.html reports/k6-cases-report.html; k6_status=0; docker run --rm -e API_BASE_URL -e K6_VUS -e K6_DURATION -v "$PWD:/work" -w /work grafana/k6:1.6.1 run --out json=reports/k6-timeseries.json performance/k6/prooflens-matrix.js || k6_status=$?; if [ -f reports/k6-summary.json ]; then node scripts/build-k6-report.mjs && node scripts/brand-generated-reports.mjs || exit $?; else echo "No K6 results were produced; no K6 report was generated."; fi; exit "$k6_status"
scripts.allure:generate: allure generate reports/allure-results --clean -o reports/allure-report && node scripts/brand-allure-report.mjs
scripts.report:build: node scripts/build-automation-reports.mjs && node scripts/build-k6-report.mjs && node scripts/brand-generated-reports.mjs
